name: @droneey/constitution-workspace
description: The workspace of the Droneey Constitution: its rules and the tools that hold them.

scripts.check:format: biome format && rumdl fmt --check . && .droneey/constitution/presets/plugins/shell/run-on-files.sh '*.sh' '*.bash' -- shfmt -d -- 'apps/docs' 'packages/@design/browser' 'packages/@design/cli' 'packages/@design/tokens' 'packages/@mutation-check/python' 'packages/@mutation-check/typescript' 'packages/brand' 'packages/constitution' && syncpack format --check && tombi format --check
scripts.check:lint: actionlint -pyflakes= && biome check --formatter-enabled=false --error-on-warnings && rumdl check . && .droneey/constitution/presets/plugins/shell/run-on-files.sh '*.sh' '*.bash' -- shellcheck -- 'apps/docs' 'packages/@design/browser' 'packages/@design/cli' 'packages/@design/tokens' 'packages/@mutation-check/python' 'packages/@mutation-check/typescript' 'packages/brand' 'packages/constitution' && syncpack lint && tombi lint && .droneey/constitution/presets/plugins/shell/run-on-files.sh '*.yaml' '*.yml' -- yamllint --strict -- 'apps/docs' 'packages/@design/browser' 'packages/@design/cli' 'packages/@design/tokens' 'packages/@mutation-check/python' 'packages/@mutation-check/typescript' 'packages/brand' 'packages/constitution'
scripts.check:secrets: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=diff.renames GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false betterleaks git . --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
scripts.fix:format: biome format --write && rumdl fmt . && .droneey/constitution/presets/plugins/shell/run-on-files.sh '*.sh' '*.bash' -- shfmt -w -- 'apps/docs' 'packages/@design/browser' 'packages/@design/cli' 'packages/@design/tokens' 'packages/@mutation-check/python' 'packages/@mutation-check/typescript' 'packages/brand' 'packages/constitution' && syncpack format && tombi format
scripts.fix:lint: biome check --write && rumdl check --fix . && syncpack fix
